reason: I'd grab the free tricks and do them at the next birthday party, but I don't pay for apps, and the free ones would probably be enough to get a laugh from the kids. Paying 99 shekels by card on some website for a trick app isn't something I'd do.
objection: Will people really be fooled, or will they see it's fake? And it's installed from a browser, not the App Store, and paid by card on a site I've never heard of. That doesn't feel safe.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks absolutely floored a room full of adults and kids at a party, so everyone asked how I did it, and the full version dropped to around 30 shekels, I might give in once.
